pages.title: Dilithium Lamp
pages.text: A dilithium block with glowstone at its centre, so the violet crystal shines with a soft, even light. It hums a single note when lit. The light is steady and gentle, more like dusk than daylight, and the note it hums sits comfortably beneath conversation. It is the lamp I leave on at night.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Dilithium glowed only faintly on its own. Adding glowstone dust gave me a violet lamp that also hums, which I find oddly soothing.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.
